Your order Shop···· has not shipped, so there is no parcel on the way and no tracking number. Both Bitfortun BS-4 units are still with us and your payment is safe on the order. The order is on hold, so nothing can leave the warehouse.

I am sorry it has taken this long.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
